scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Poisson ratios from lattice parameters and refits Lorentzians from line cuts; uses paper-reported values as hidden gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported gold values for Poisson ratios, q0, xi, and tolerances
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper (abstract, Fig. 4, text): ν_ba=0.16, ν_ca=0.11; q0≈3.53, 4.48 r.l.u.; ξ≈4 unit cells; temperature and strain independence.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantities the reproduction aims to recover, verified against the paper.

outputs.description: Lattice parameters and strain values for each strain condition.
Poisson ratios ν_ba and ν_ca with 1σ uncertainties.
Line cuts in H direction across designated Bragg reflections.
Fitted Lorentzian peak parameters for strain-induced diffuse scattering peaks.

output_contract.notes: Scored artifacts cover the complete experimental XRD analysis pipeline. The checker may recompute Poisson ratios from lattice_parameters.csv and may refit Lorentzians from diffuse_line_cuts.csv to verify the reported q0 and correlation length.

steps.description: Validate lattice_parameters.csv has required columns and epsilon_aa values are negative for compressed strains.
Recompute Poisson ratios from lattice_parameters.csv via linear regression and compare to paper gold ν_ba=0.16, ν_ca=0.11 with 10% relative tolerance.
Validate diffuse_line_cuts.csv has required columns and non-zero intensity entries.

Refit Lorentzian to diffuse_line_cuts.csv for strain-induced peaks, extract q0, ξ; compare to paper gold (q0 3.53, 4.48 r.l.u., ξ 4 unit cells) within tolerances; verify signal appears at 0.05% strain, saturates by 0.2% strain, and shows no strong temperature dependence.
